```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/online-shop">

  <!-- Collaboration with one participant (the organisation) -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Org" name="Online Shop" processRef="process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process definition -->
  <bpmn:process id="process" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_selectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_addToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_saveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_enterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_enterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_enterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="lane_system" name="E‑Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_checkLogin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_allSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_finishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Pg_split1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_waitBank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Pg_paymentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Pg_paymentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_prepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Pg_joinAll</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_completeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_loginFailed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_addressEquality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Customer logs in" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_checkLogin" name="Check login credentials" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_login" name="Login successful?" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_loginFailed" name="Shopping experience stopped" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_selectProduct" name="Select product" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_addToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_saveProduct" name="Save product" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_allSelected" name="All products selected?" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_finishOrder" name="Finish order" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Pg_split1" name="Parallel split (payment & shipment)" />

    <!-- Payment branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_enterPayment" name="Enter payment data" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Pg_paymentSplit" name="Parallel split (bank & address)" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_waitBank" name="Wait for bank confirmation" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_enterShipping" name="Enter shipping address" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_addressEquality" name="Shipping address = billing address?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_enterBilling" name="Enter billing address" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Pg_paymentJoin" name="Join payment activities" />

    <!-- Shipment branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_prepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment" />

    <!-- Join both branches -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Pg_joinAll" name="Join payment and shipment" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_completeOrder" name="Complete order" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_success" name="Order finished" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_start_checkLogin" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_checkLogin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_checkLogin_loginGw" sourceRef="Task_checkLogin" targetRef="Gw_login" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_login_yes" sourceRef="Gw_login" targetRef="Task_selectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_login_no" sourceRef="Gw_login" targetRef="End_loginFailed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">!loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_select_addToCart" sourceRef="Task_selectProduct" targetRef="Task_addToCart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_addToCart_saveProduct" sourceRef="Task_addToCart" targetRef="Task_saveProduct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_saveProduct_allSelectedGw" sourceRef="Task_saveProduct" targetRef="Gw_allSelected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_allSelected_no" sourceRef="Gw_allSelected" targetRef="Task_selectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">!allSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_allSelected_yes" sourceRef="Gw_allSelected" targetRef="Task_finishOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">allSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_finish_split" sourceRef="Task_finishOrder" targetRef="Pg_split1" />

    <!-- Parallel split into payment and shipment -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_payment" sourceRef="Pg_split1" targetRef="Task_enterPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_shipment" sourceRef="Pg_split1" targetRef="Task_prepareShipment" />

    <!-- Payment branch flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_enterPayment_paymentSplit" sourceRef="Task_enterPayment" targetRef="Pg_paymentSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_paymentSplit_bank" sourceRef="Pg_paymentSplit" targetRef="Task_waitBank" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_paymentSplit_address" sourceRef="Pg_paymentSplit" targetRef="Task_enterShipping" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_shipping_addressEquality" sourceRef="Task_enterShipping" targetRef="Gw_addressEquality" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_addressEquality_yes" sourceRef="Gw_addressEquality" targetRef="Pg_paymentJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">shippingEqualsBilling</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_addressEquality_no" sourceRef="Gw_addressEquality" targetRef="Task_enterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">!shippingEqualsBilling</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_enterBilling_toJoin" sourceRef="Task_enterBilling" targetRef="Pg_paymentJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_waitBank_toJoin" sourceRef="Task_waitBank" targetRef="Pg_paymentJoin" />

    <!-- Shipment branch flow -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_prepareShipment_toJoinAll" sourceRef="Task_prepareShipment" targetRef="Pg_joinAll" />

    <!-- Join payment and shipment -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_paymentJoin_toJoinAll" sourceRef="Pg_paymentJoin" targetRef="Pg_joinAll" />

    <!-- Final steps -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_joinAll_complete" sourceRef="Pg_joinAll" targetRef="Task_completeOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_complete_end" sourceRef="Task_completeOrder" targetRef="End_success" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```

We need to produce BPMN XML for described process. No external pool; only one pool for the organisation (the online shop). Lanes: actors: Customer, E-Shop system (or system). Also maybe Bank? The text mentions bank confirms payment - could be external party. Could model as separate pool (external) with message flow. But requirement: one pool for organisation and one lane for each actor (person, role, department or system) that performs activities. If text names no actor, use single lane. Here actors: Customer (human), E-Shop system (system), Bank (external). The bank may be a separate pool (external). Since they said one pool for organisation, external can be separate black-box pool. But they said use one pool for organisation and one lane for each actor that performs activities. The bank is external but is part of process? It "confirms payment". Could be modeled as a task "Wait for bank confirmation" in system lane. Simpler: treat bank confirmation as a system task, no separate pool. So lanes: Customer, System (E-Shop). We'll have start event: "Customer logs into the E-Shop system". Then system checks credentials (Task: "Check credentials") wait maybe a receive task? But they'll have "login confirmation". Use system task: "Check login credentials". Exclusive gateway: "Login successful?" yes -> continue, no -> end (shopping experience stops). After login success, customer selects product (Task: "Select product") then adds to cart (Task: "Add product to shopping cart") then maybe "Save product"? The description: "add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected." That's three tasks: Add to cart, Save product, Check all products selected? Could combine but they said each activity becomes a task named with words of text (verb and object). So "Add product to shopping cart", "Save product", "Check if all products selected". Those can be in customer lane or system? Probably customer adds and saves; system checks. We'll place them in Customer lane for simplicity. Then exclusive gateway "All products selected?" If no, loop back to "Select product". If yes, proceed to order finishing.

Then order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared. That's a parallel split: "Finish order" (system task) then parallel: "Prepare payment" and "Prepare shipment". Actually "order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared." So after finishing order, payment preparation and shipment preparation happen in parallel. So a parallel gateway splits into two branches: Payment branch and Shipment branch. Then they may join after they complete? Probably later they join before final order completion? The description: "Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system." So after both payment (including address) and shipment prepared? Actually after payment and shipment prepared, they also need address entry and payment confirmation. Let's map payment branch: Customer enters payment data (Task: "Enter payment data") then wait for bank confirmation (Task: "Wait for bank confirmation"). While waiting, customer can enter shipping address (Task: "Enter shipping address") and possibly billing address. This is parallel: while waiting for bank confirmation, the address entry happens concurrently. So within payment branch we may have parallel after "Enter payment data". One path: Wait for bank confirmation (system task). Another path: Enter shipping address (customer task) (and optionally billing address). The addresses can be in same branch sequentially: "Enter shipping address" then maybe "Enter billing address (if different)". We'll include a decision: "Is shipping address equal to billing address?" if no -> "Enter billing address". This is exclusive decision.

After both bank confirmation and address entry steps are done, then final order finish by system (end event). Also need shipment preparation maybe done earlier and combine later.

Thus overall flow:

Start -> System task "Check login credentials" -> Exclusive gateway "Login successful?" Yes -> Customer lane: "Select product" -> "Add product to shopping cart" -> "Save product" -> "Check if all products selected?" (gateway). If No -> loop back to "Select product". If Yes -> System task "Finish order" -> Parallel gateway (split) -> Branch A (Payment) -> Task "Enter payment data" (Customer) -> Parallel gateway (split) -> Sub-branch A1: Task "Wait for bank confirmation" (System) ; Sub-branch A2: Task "Enter shipping address" (Customer) -> Exclusive gateway "Shipping address equals billing address?" Yes -> (skip billing) else -> Task "Enter billing address". Then after both A1 and A2 (including optional billing) join via parallel gateway (join) -> continue to ??? maybe join parallel with shipment branch.

Branch B (Shipment): Task "Prepare shipment" (System). Then after both branches join via parallel gateway (join) -> System task "Complete order" (or final end). Then End event.
